exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Jewellery How often do you wear jewellery? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Jewellery What type of jewellery do you like best? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Jewellery When do people like to give jewellery in your country? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Jewellery Have you ever given jewellery to someone as a gift? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe an interesting TV programme you watched about a science topic. You should say: what science topic this TV programme was about when you saw this TV programme what you learnt from this TV programme about a science topic and explain why you found this TV programme interesting.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Science and the public How interested are most people in your country in science?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Science and the public Why do you think children today might be better at science than their parents?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Science and the public How do you suggest the public can learn more about scientific developments?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Scientific discoveries What do you think are the most important scientific discoveries in the last 100 years?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Scientific discoveries Do you agree or disagree that there are no more major scientific discoveries left to make?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Scientific discoveries Who should pay for scientific research - governments or private companies?
